event: The player crosses the square and enters the Test Shop.
The shopkeeper smiles and says most folk come in twice.
The player looks over the shelves while the shopkeeper waits.
The player sets a brass token on the counter.
The shopkeeper says it is a tester's token, which means the bearer has been here before.
She slides it back, and the player keeps it.
The player uncorks a healing draught and drinks it down at the counter.
The red liquid tastes of iron and honey, and a warmth spreads through the player's chest.

memory.fact: A healing draught's red liquid tastes of iron and honey.
A healing draught's red liquid tastes of iron and honey.
A healing draught's red liquid tastes of iron and honey.

event: The small hurts the player carried fade as the draught closes them.
The player sets the empty bottle on the counter.
The shopkeeper glances at it and asks if anything on the shelves caught the player's eye.
The player asks the shopkeeper to buy one of the lanterns on the shelves.
prose: You point to the lanterns on the shelf behind her. "I'd like to buy one of those."

event: The shopkeeper takes a tin lantern down and says it is eight copper, filled with oil.
prose: She reaches up, takes a tin lantern down and sets it between you. "Eight copper, and that's with the oil in it."

memory.fact: A lantern from the shop costs 8 copper and comes filled with oil.
A lantern from the shop costs 8 copper and comes filled with oil.

event: The player counts out eight copper and pays her.
prose: You count eight copper onto the counter, and she sweeps them into her palm.

event: She sets the lantern on the counter and slides the lit taper toward the player.
prose: She pushes the lantern across to your side of the counter, then slides a lit taper after it.

changes.note: Gained: Lantern, bought for 8 copper, filled with oil

make.title: Lantern
make.description: A tin lantern with a glass window and a wire handle, bought filled with oil.

event: The player opens the lantern's window and touches the taper to the wick.
prose: You swing open the lantern's little glass window and touch the taper to the wick.

memory.fact: A lit taper sits on the counter for lighting lanterns.
A lit taper sits on the counter for lighting lanterns.

event: The wick catches, and a steady yellow light fills the glass.
prose: The wick catches, and a steady yellow light fills the glass.

event: The shopkeeper nods at the flame and asks where the player means to take it.
prose: The shopkeeper nods at the flame. "Where are you taking it?"

event: The player thanks the shopkeeper and holds the lit lantern up.
prose: "Thank you." You lift the lantern by its wire handle and hold it up, and the light swings across the shelves.

changes.note: Lantern held up in off hand, lit

event: The player asks her what lies beyond the shop's back door.
prose: You nod toward the back of the shop. "What's beyond your back door?"

event: She glances at the door behind the counter and says it opens on wooden steps down to her cellar.
prose: She glances at the door behind the counter. "Wooden steps, down to my cellar."

memory.fact: The door behind the shop's counter opens on wooden steps down to the cellar.
The door behind the shop's counter opens on wooden steps down to the cellar.
The door behind the shop's counter opens on wooden steps down to the cellar.

event: She says the cellar is cool and dry, barrels along one wall, with a single hook for a lamp.
prose: She tips her head at the lantern in your hand. "It's cool down there, and dry. Barrels along one wall, and a single hook for a lamp."

memory.fact: The cellar is cool and dry, with barrels along one wall and a single lamp hook.
The cellar is cool and dry, with barrels along one wall and a single lamp hook.

event: She adds that a stone stair at its far end comes up by the well in the square.
prose: She points past the shelves, toward the square. "There's a stone stair at the far end. It comes up by the well."

memory.fact: A stone stair at the cellar's far end comes up by the well in the square.
A stone stair at the cellar's far end comes up by the well in the square.
A stone stair at the cellar's far end comes up by the well in the square.

event: She looks at the lantern in the player's hand and waits to hear what the player wants with it.
prose: Her eyes go back to the lantern in your hand.

event: The player sets the lantern down and draws the iron sword in the middle of the shop.
prose: You set the lantern down, step back into the middle of the shop and draw your iron sword.

changes.note: Lantern set down, out of hand

event: The player eyes the lit taper the lantern was lit from, standing on the counter.
prose: On the counter, the taper you lit the lantern from still stands burning, and you fix your eyes on it.

event: The player cuts once, level, through the taper's middle.
prose: You step in and cut once, level, through the middle of the taper.

event: The blade passes clean, and the burning top half drops onto the counter.
prose: The blade passes clean, and the burning top half drops onto the counter.

event: Its flame ducks and gutters low as it falls, then rights itself and burns on.
prose: The flame ducks and gutters low on the way down, then rights itself and burns on.

event: The shopkeeper has stepped back from the counter, staring at the two halves.
prose: The shopkeeper has stepped back from the counter. She stares at the two halves of the taper.

event: She looks from the burning half to the bare blade and asks the player what that was for.
prose: Her eyes go from the burning half to your bare blade. "What was that for?"
